verdict.rationale: Simular documents a REST API with named endpoints and publishes an llms.txt docs index, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index, prose endpoint listings and the MCP server are adjacent features, not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
